Active zone. Turn it when it drops under 40 °C.

Moisture — sponge test

Wring one squeeze, not a stream. Add water or greens.

Worm bin population

No escapees on the lid. Eggshells are working.

Browns-to-greens ratio

Too many greens. Shredded cardboard, top layer.

Odour check
  • Earthy = fine. Sour or rancid = add browns, turn, wait.
  • Fruit flies mean exposed greens — bury them 10 cm deep.
  • Never meat, dairy or oils in the worm bin.
